-## Unsupported Products
-### Unmanaged Fly Postgres (Unsupported)
-Fly Postgres is a PostgreSQL database that you create and then manage yourself. Fly Postgres clusters are Fly Apps that consist of Machines, volumes, and any configured extra memory. The Machine price and volume price for Fly Postgres are the same as any other Machine and volume you'd run on Fly.io.
